name: app.chartlink/chartlink
description: Charts and tables for AI agents with live-updating embed links. Draft from one message, look at the preview, publish; update the numbers later and every embed follows. No accounts: POST /api/signup returns a key.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <chartlink API key>. Get one with POST https://chartlink.app/api/signup (no account).

environment_variables.name: CHARTLINK_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: chartlink API key (viz_...). POST https://chartlink.app/api/signup returns one, no account needed.
